service.description: Send Email with settings in EmailTemplate entity record

parameter.name: toAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of to email addresses

parameter.name: ccAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of CC email addresses

parameter.name: bccAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of BCC email addresses

parameter.name: extraHeaders
parameter.description: Header fields to add, name to value: a list email's List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post (RFC 2369, RFC 8058). A name the message's own fields write (From, To, Subject, Message-ID, Content-Type and the like) or a value with a line break is left out. They are kept in the EmailMessage's headersString, so a send again keeps the List- headers.

parameter.name: inReplyTo
parameter.description: The Message-ID this one replies to, with its angle brackets. A value that is not a message ID is left out.

parameter.name: references
parameter.description: Message IDs of the thread, oldest first, separated by spaces; the oldest are dropped to keep the header to one line.

parameter.name: replyToAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated Reply-To addresses that replace the template's, such as a scoped reply address. A value with a line break or without addresses is left out.

parameter.name: deliveryOutcome
parameter.description: On an SMTP failure: retryable for an explicit temporary rejection, permanent for an explicit permanent rejection, uncertain when acceptance is unknown.

parameter.name: messageId
parameter.description: From the Message-ID email header field.

parameter.name: emailMessageId
parameter.description: If createEmailMessage=true the ID of the EmailMessage record.

service.description: Defines input parameters matching what is available when an Email ECA rule is called.

parameter.name: bodyPartList
parameter.description: List of Map for each body part. If the message is not multi-part will have a single entry.

parameter.name: headers
parameter.description: All header names (keys) are converted to lower case for consistency. If multiple values for a header name are found they will be put in a List.
